title: Plantaciones
goal: Read about the plantation economy behind the mines: an early industrial-scale sugar mill, why Brazil received more enslaved Africans than anywhere else, and the cacao fortune behind a famous independence name.

items: Contrast the plantation model with the Andean mining model.

Describe the 'gran cacao' elite and its connection to Simón Bolívar's family.
